method.en: Qualitative investigation priorities within the existing 37-property pool. The network and third-party orders rank the same selected ten. They are not return rankings, investment qualifications, measured probabilities or a nationwide optimum.
method.zh: 现有37址研究池内的定性调查优先级；网络和第三方顺序均在同一所选十址内排序。不是收益排名、投资合格名单、测量概率或全美最优结论。

boundary.en: All ten remain pending. No evidence gate, payback threshold, financial input or qualification decision changes in this release. Ronald retains the v0.9 conditional tests; no unsupported new payback estimates were created for the other nine.
boundary.zh: 十址均仍待核实。本版不改变证据门槛、回本阈值、财务输入或资格判断。Ronald保留v0.9条件测算，其他九址不新增缺乏依据的回本估计。

evidenceScope.en: Priorities approved October 30, 2026, using retained public evidence. Supply distances and record counts are from the October 29 snapshot, are straight-line rather than driving distances, and do not prove demand. This is not a new nationwide supply scan or ten completed commercial reviews.
evidenceScope.zh: 优先级于2026年10月30日确认，依据保留公开证据。供给距离和记录数来自10月29日快照，距离为直线而非驾车距离，不能证明需求。本轮不是全国新普查或完成十址商业尽调。

reason.en: The most testable conditional model in this pool. Nearby comparisons and explicit demand, price, peak-control and cost sensitivities make the next evidence consequential. 59 paid sessions/day is still unverified.
reason.zh: 本池中可检验性最强的条件模型。附近参照及明确的订单、价格、控峰和成本敏感度，使下一步证据能直接改变判断。59次付费充电/天仍未经证实。

nextChecks.en: Confirm owner/H-E-B parking authority; obtain price-matched paid transactions from nearby operators, PEC meter/tariff/capacity terms, Tesla control performance, and a complete matching EPC/connection/site quote.
nextChecks.zh: 确认业主/H-E-B停车授权；获取附近运营商与价格匹配的付费交易、PEC电表/费率/容量条款、Tesla控制性能及范围一致的完整EPC/接电/场地报价。

stopCondition.en: Do not upgrade if verified demand and complete costs fail the joint downside/base gates. A favorable base target alone is insufficient.
stopCondition.zh: 若已核实需求和完整成本仍不能通过保守/基准联合门槛，不升级。单独基准目标盈利不够。

reason.en: 24-hour retail and a retained nearest-DCFC distance of 4.1 straight-line miles justify a bounded tariff/control and demand inquiry. Parcel and PSE evidence offer concrete next steps.
reason.zh: 全天零售场景，保留快照最近DCFC直线距离4.1英里，值得定向核实费率、控峰及需求；地块与PSE资料提供了明确路径。

nextChecks.en: Confirm the PSE meter, eligible tariff, actual program availability and peak-control design; then test paid demand and full costs for a smaller phased project.
nextChecks.zh: 确认PSE电表、适用费率、真实项目名额和控峰设计；再检验较小分期项目的付费需求及完整成本。

stopCondition.en: Ordinary tariff economics may fail. Do not assume preferential electricity or maximum rebates; pause paid design if the complete bill and paid demand fail the unchanged gates.
stopCondition.zh: 普通费率可能使经济性失败。不得默认优惠电价或最高补贴；若完整账单与付费需求不能支持原门槛，暂停付费设计。

reason.en: US 290 corridor: one DCFC record within ten miles in the retained supply snapshot. Potential incremental network value merits an access and utility check.
reason.zh: US290走廊：保留供给快照十英里内一条DCFC记录，潜在网络增量值得先查通行和供电。

nextChecks.en: Identify the actual Oncor/Bluebonnet meter; resolve highway right-of-way and driveway plans before estimating passing-EV capture, paid volume and connection cost.
nextChecks.zh: 确认实际Oncor/Bluebonnet电表；先解决道路征地和出入口规划，再估计过境EV捕获、付费量和接电成本。

stopCondition.en: Downgrade if access is impaired or supply removes the incremental need. Do not transfer PEC tariffs to this property.
stopCondition.zh: 若出入口受损或供给消除增量需求则降级；不能把PEC费率套用到本址。

reason.en: The retained nearest DCFC is 4.2 straight-line miles away. AMCAP’s May 2026 site plan provides a specific parking/management discussion basis, not granted site rights.
reason.zh: 保留快照最近DCFC直线距离4.2英里。AMCAP的2026年5月场地图提供停车和管理方讨论基础，但不代表已获场地权利。

nextChecks.en: Confirm AMCAP/WinCo parking authority and the actual meter; obtain utility capacity, time-of-use/demand billing and full construction scope, then validate paid demand.
nextChecks.zh: 确认AMCAP/WinCo停车授权和实际电表；获取容量、分时/需量电费及完整建设范围，再验证付费需求。

stopCondition.en: Marketing traffic is not charging orders. Exclude unawarded PGE support; stop if rights or the complete verified case cannot support the joint gates.
stopCondition.zh: 营销车流不是充电订单。排除未获批PGE支持；若权利或完整已核实方案不能支持联合门槛则暂停。

reason.en: A canceled same-address project and a current Phase 12 town-eligible RFP make restart and equipment eligibility decisive questions. No site award or Tesla compatibility has been established.
reason.zh: 同址项目曾取消，当前Phase12 RFP包含Machias，重启与设备资格是关键问题；尚未证实本址获奖或Tesla兼容性。

nextChecks.en: Ask Hannaford/the prior operator and Efficiency Maine to resolve cancellation, existing rights, Tesla hardware/protocol compliance and reimbursement conditions. Published deadline: April 30, 2027, 23:59 Eastern.
nextChecks.zh: 向Hannaford/原运营方及Efficiency Maine核实取消原因、现有权利、Tesla硬件/协议合规和报销条件。公布截止：2027年4月30日23:59美东时间。

stopCondition.en: No compliant Tesla route means no Tesla Supercharger recommendation; a generic DCFC award is not interchangeable. Unawarded support is sensitivity only.
stopCondition.zh: 没有合规Tesla路径就不能推荐为Tesla超充；通用DCFC资助不可混用。未获批支持仅作敏感度分析。

reason.en: A named property filing and utility route make follow-up actionable. The nearby 1715 E Broad charging project is a potentially decisive counterexample to the early network thesis.
reason.zh: 具名业主申报和供电路径使跟进可执行；附近1715 E Broad充电项目可能直接推翻早期网络假设。

nextChecks.en: Verify current operation, power, pricing and queues at 1715 E Broad before H-E-B/Oncor design work. It is across from 1670 E Broad, not the same parcel. Obtain actual meter and connection terms.
nextChecks.zh: 先核实1715 E Broad的当前运营、功率、价格和排队，再做H-E-B/Oncor设计。它与1670 E Broad在不同地块；获取实际电表及接电条款。

stopCondition.en: Downgrade if nearby supply meets demand without demonstrated overflow. Gas-generator nameplate power does not prove spare charging capacity.
stopCondition.zh: 若邻近供给已满足需求且无溢出证据则降级。燃气发电铭牌功率不能证明充电可用容量。

reason.en: An existing EVgo operator and historical charging plans create identifiable routes to throughput, asset and rights evidence. This is an incremental project, not an empty parking lot.
reason.zh: 已有EVgo运营商与历史充电图纸，能明确追查吞吐、资产和权利。本址是增量项目，不能当成空白停车场。

nextChecks.en: Confirm WinCo/EVgo exclusivity and expansion rights, incremental paid demand, reusable asset condition and a complete incremental investment quote.
nextChecks.zh: 确认WinCo/EVgo排他和扩容权利、增量付费需求、可复用资产状态及完整增量投资报价。

stopCondition.en: Pause without expansion rights or new demand. Use incremental cash flows; existing station revenue cannot all be credited to new investment.
stopCondition.zh: 没有扩容权或新增需求则暂停。使用增量现金流，不能把既有站点全部收入归到新增投资。

reason.en: NHEC’s historical announcement names ReVision Energy and a battery-integrated charger, providing a route to operating and meter records. Current availability remains unresolved.
reason.zh: NHEC历史公告具名ReVision Energy及储能快充，提供运营和电表记录追查路径；当前可用状态仍待确认。

nextChecks.en: Request current status, downtime cause, paid logs, battery/meter intervals, asset/data rights and replacement costs from ReVision, the host and NHEC.
nextChecks.zh: 向ReVision、物业和NHEC索取当前状态、停机原因、付费记录、储能/电表时序、资产/数据权及替换成本。

stopCondition.en: An installation announcement is not uptime evidence. Without a lawful takeover/cooperation route, retain as a comparator rather than a development site.
stopCondition.zh: 安装公告不证明当前正常运营。没有合法接管/合作路径，则仅作参照，不继续开发。

reason.en: US 93 retail node with a retained nearest-DCFC gap of 67.7 straight-line miles. Network coverage is a stronger hypothesis than investment returns; merchant address evidence exists.
reason.zh: US93零售节点，保留快照最近DCFC直线距离67.7英里。网络覆盖假设强于收益证据，已有经营者地址资料。

nextChecks.en: Reconcile the street address, map entrance and parcel; verify 24-hour parking, actual utility, year-round passing EVs, winter paid demand and connection costs.
nextChecks.zh: 核对街道地址、地图入口和地块；确认全天停车、实际供电商、全年过境EV、冬季付费需求及接电成本。

stopCondition.en: A large gap is not paid demand. Pause if seasonal demand and grid costs cannot satisfy the same investment gates; network priority grants no exemption.
stopCondition.zh: 大供给缺口不是付费需求。低季需求与接电成本不能满足同一投资门槛则暂停；网络优先级不构成豁免。

projectScope.zh: 仅已取消项目恢复/重设计

reason.en: Cancellation records and a Pacific Power planning/upgrade route justify checking asset reuse. Nearby DCFC supply about 0.2 straight-line miles away limits the incremental thesis.
reason.zh: 取消档案及Pacific Power规划/升级路径值得查资产复用；约0.2英里直线距离的DCFC供给限制增量假设。

nextChecks.en: Resolve cancellation causes, existing rights, reusable civil/electrical works, Tesla eligibility and complete incremental costs before evaluating a restart.
nextChecks.zh: 先明确取消原因、现有权利、可复用土建/电气工程、Tesla资格及完整增量成本，再评估重启。

stopCondition.en: Do not present this as an ordinary greenfield recommendation while cancellation, rights and incremental demand remain unresolved.
stopCondition.zh: 取消原因、权利和增量需求未解决前，不得作为普通新建推荐。
